g.text: ENTERPRISE HOSPITAL SYSTEM - CLOUD ARCHITECTURE & DEVSECOPS BLUEPRINT
Decoupled Multi-Repo CI/CD | Zero-Trust OIDC Federation | CloudFront Single-Origin Proxy | 3-Tier Isolated VPC | Elastic ECS Fargate | Multi-AZ RDS
Prevents API key & DB token exposure
Pushed to Amazon ECR via SHA Digest
GitHub OIDC token exchanges for short-lived
Distribution ID: E1EIZP6V20O6OY | Single-Origin Reverse Proxy Architecture (Eliminates CORS Complexity!)
Origin Access Control (OAC) Enabled (Zero Public S3 Bucket!)
Path: / (All Static Assets, CSS, JS, HTML5 Routing)
Origin 2: ALB Dynamic API Reverse Proxy
Routes directly to backend Application Load Balancer
Dual-AZ High Availability (us-east-1a, us-east-1b) | Network Isolation & Strict Security Groups
TIER 1: PUBLIC SUBNETS (10.0.1.0/24 & 10.0.2.0/24) - Ingress & Egress Routing
Target Group: Forward traffic to ECS Fargate on Port 8080
TIER 2: PRIVATE APPLICATION SUBNETS (10.0.11.0/24 & 10.0.12.0/24) - Isolated Microservices
Serverless Container Execution | 0.5 vCPU, 1GB RAM | Auto-Scales based on demand
Security Group: Ingress restricted strictly to ALB SG
Zero Idle VM Waste: Cost drops to zero off-peak!
Non-Root User: Runs as unprivileged appuser (UID 1000)
TIER 3: PRIVATE DATABASE SUBNETS (10.0.21.0/24 & 10.0.22.0/24) - Isolated Data Persistence
✓ Zero Public Route: Completely isolated from internet; accepts traffic ONLY from ECS SG
Terraform Remote State & Concurrency Locking (GitOps State Tier)
S3 Backend: hospital-system-terraform-state-dev (Versioned & KMS Encrypted) | DynamoDB Table: hospital-system-tf-lock-dev
Whogohost External DNS Records (Live Domain Resolution)
CPU & Memory Utilization, Task Count Tracking
HTTP 200 OK latency, 4xx/5xx Error Spike Alarms
Database connections, disk IOPS & free storage
